description: Use for 'which accounts have an open buying signal?'. Returns open leads (id eop_..., dated proof with links, what it usually means for what you sell, rough time frame); filter closing_soon returns the ones that usually wind down within 30 days. Use the returned id with get_best_contact, get_project_updates and mark_opportunity. Saved records only.

held.description: Leads held back by the quality gate (no dated, linked proof).

usually_means.description: What this usually means for what the workspace sells. An interpretation, not confirmed intent.

what_we_found.description: The dated proof, newest first, each with a link to its source when there is one.

date.description: When the event happened, else when Intakra first saw it.
